modern_ite.configuration.title: MITE: Modern ITE Gameplay Settings
modern_ite.config.edit.tooltip: Open settings by category; hover over each setting for when it takes effect.
modern_ite.config.scope: Most saved values apply immediately. Initial attributes and random traits affect new mobs; ores affect new chunks; existing cooldowns remain. Singleplayer worlds share this instance's settings. Multiplayer uses the server's settings.
modern_ite.config.server_owned: These gameplay settings were synchronized by the server and are read-only. Ask the server owner to change the server configuration.
modern_ite.config.search: Search setting names, categories or legacy keys…
modern_ite.config.values.count: %s effective settings · Scroll to browse · Hover for defaults

modern_ite.config.conqueror_damage_boost: Conqueror damage per level per prior hit
Extra damage = enchantment rank x this player's prior successful melee hits on the same target x this value. Added to player stepped damage; both share the successful-hit counter.

modern_ite.config.reference_spawning.too: Default: ITE 2.0.28 reference spawning with independent height caps, original nearby crowd protection and the old ITE natural pools. In both presets, ITE mobs spawn automatically only after 64 complete days (day 65 onward); later species dates still apply. Turn off for the existing custom rules. Existing values and monsters are retained; splitting is unchanged.
modern_ite.config.spawning_custom_only: Applies only to the custom preset. Switch presets to edit; the saved value is retained.
modern_ite.config.spawning_rules.tooltip: Choose reference or custom spawning. Adjust splitting and support density, candidate weights and spawners. Grey legacy natural-spawning settings are retained but inactive in reference mode. Saving applies immediately.
modern_ite.config.spawning_live: Save to apply; grey settings require Custom
modern_ite.config.mob_max_spawn_count_ch: Custom preset only: floor(value * eligible chunk union / 128), plus date allowance and final blood multiplier; both bands share it. Reference uses base 50, divisor 256 ordinarily or 128 on blood dates, then doubles the deep cap.
modern_ite.config.mob_max_spawn_count_da: Custom preset only: minimum date allowance, default 100. Ignored by reference mode.
Custom preset only: 0 is unlimited; positive values cap the date allowance without going below its minimum. Ignored by reference mode.
modern_ite.config.local_hostile_limit.to: Splitting and non-encounter support admission cap within 32 blocks horizontally and 8 vertically of players, default 32. Reference natural spawning separately uses original 8/10/12 crowd protection; custom mode also applies this to natural spawning. 0 stops additions, retaining existing mobs.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_local_hosti: Blood moon splitting and non-encounter support admission cap within 32 blocks horizontally and 8 vertically, default 48. Reference natural spawning uses original crowd protection; custom mode also applies this to natural spawning. 0 stops additions.
modern_ite.config.hostile_spawn_groups.t: Custom preset only: groups attempted per eligible chunk each pass, default 3. 0 stops attempts. Reference mode uses the original usual 3 groups.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_hostile_spa: Custom preset only: blood-date groups per eligible chunk each pass, default 4. 0 stops attempts. Reference mode uses the original usual 3 groups.
modern_ite.config.hostile_spawn_attempts: Custom preset only: attempts per group, default 4. 0 stops natural attempts. Reference mode uses the original usual 4 attempts. Existing monsters are retained.
